sn20.12:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || Assuttha no tumhe bhikkhave rattiyā paccusasamayam siṅgālassa vassamānassāti || || Evam bhante || || Siyā kho bhikkhave tasmiṃ jarasiṅgāle yā kāci kataññutā kataveditā || na tveva idhekacce sakyaputtiyapaṭiññe pi yā kāci kataññutā kataveditā || || Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ || || Kataññuno bhavissāma katavedino || amhesu appakam pi kataṃ mā nassisatīti || || Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Dvādasamaṃ || || Opamma saṃyuttam || || Tassa
sn20.12:2.0: uddānaṃ || || Kūṭaṃ Nakhasikhaṃ Kulaṃ || Ukkā Satti Danuggaho || Aṇi Kaliṅgaro Nāgo || Biḷāro dve Siṅgālakā ti || ||
